avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C8 induction reduces repaglinide metabolism and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; may require dose adjustment if unavoidable

avoid_supplements.name: Gemfibrozil
avoid_supplements.mechanism: OATP1B1 inhibition increases repaglinide levels and hypoglycemia risk

avoid_supplements.name: Clarithromycin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly elevates repaglinide concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or reduce repaglinide dose; monitor blood glucose closely

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate hypoglycemic effect through insulin secretion
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; inform patient of additive hypoglycemic risk

caution_supplements.name: Chromium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance insulin sensitivity and lower glucose independent of repaglinide
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for hypoglycemia; coordinate supplementation with provider

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays repaglinide absorption and peak concentration, reducing glucose control efficacy
avoid_foods.action: Take repaglinide 15-30 minutes before meals; avoid heavy fat intake at dosing time

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase repaglinide exposure
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased hypoglycemic symptoms

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Potentiates hypoglycemic effect and may impair hypoglycemia awareness
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate amounts; consume with food; monitor glucose

monitoring_notes: Repaglinide is rapidly absorbed and metabolized; timing relative to meals and CYP3A4/2C8 inhibitors is critical for efficacy and safety. Monitor fasting and postprandial glucose, HbA1c, and symptoms of hypoglycemia, particularly when initiating, adjusting doses, or adding interacting agents.
